# Chandu Mobile Care

> Chandu Mobile Care is a mobile phone shop and repair service enquiry point on Sabbavaram Road in Lankelapalem, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Business details
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 70368 59233
- Address: 8-82, Sabbavaram Road, Lankelapalem, Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh 531019
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/place/CHANDU+MOBILE+CARE/@17.688256,83.096552,17z/
- Brands shown on the website: Apple, Samsung, vivo, OPPO, OnePlus, Redmi and realme

## Products and services
- Smartphones, mobile accessories, spare parts and repair enquiries
- Accessories include cases, tempered glass, chargers, cables, earbuds and headphones
- Repair topics include display and touch, batteries, charging and audio, software, cameras, hardware and water damage
- Product examples on the website are illustrative. Stock, colour, specifications and prices can change; contact the shop to confirm current availability.
- Repair work and estimates should be confirmed directly with the shop for the exact device model and fault.
